name: island-camping-bangladesh
description: Hipcamp-inspired fullstack adventure and eco-camping web application for Bangladesh islands

scripts.setup:backend: cd backend && python3 -m venv venv && ./venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix apps/web && mkdir -p dist/apps/web && cp -R apps/web/dist/. dist/apps/web/
